_comment:
Hand-curated structured effects for the procs the derived generator cannot reach — the thin hand-override layer for the genuinely underivable. It exists so a proc lookup never has to fall back to parsing the `mechanics` prose, which is what let that parser be retired. Each entry is a FAITHFUL transcription of the proc's binary-sourced `mechanics` string, structured the way the generator would emit it.

Why an entry is here, by bucket (the `_groups` headings): Rebirth-only sets, which are absent from the Homecoming export the generator reads; Create_Entity pet summons, where the binary encodes a summon redirect rather than a dashboard stat; PBAoE ally buffs, whose value scales by the slotted power so there is no clean self contribution; self meters and conditional stacks, which no surface models; and utility pieces.

Foe debuff, mez and knock effects carry `target: "foe"` so no dashboard path applies them — they are display-only. Two foe procs where the Homecoming binary disagrees with the hand string are transcribed to MATCH the hand value, flagged in `_notes`; resolving them is an in-game verification, not a data change.

`emit-contract.cjs` applies this table seventh of the eight merges that build the contract's `proc-data` section, REPLACING an entry's whole `effects` array — unlike `proc-variable-controls.json`, which patches fields onto what is already there. Keys match `proc-data.json` keys exactly; a key matching no entry is silently ignored, the way the TypeScript merge loop was. Order is not sorted: it is the bucket grouping `_groups` records.

Self meters / conditional stacks / utility (not dashboard-modeled)

_notes.Chance for Stun: Stupefy generic "Chance for Stun": Foe(Disorient Mag 2) for 8s.
_notes.Chance for Confusion: Coercive Persuasion "Chance for Confusion": Foe(Confusion) for 10s (Execute_Power redirect — magnitude not in the string).
_notes.Winter's Bite: Chance for Recharge Slow: Winter's Bite "Recharge Slow": hand Foe(-Recharge 20%) for 20s. NB the Homecoming binary shows the proc as -Speed 20% (RunningSpeed), not -Recharge — transcribed to the hand value.
_notes.Superior Avalanche: Recharge/Chance for: Superior Avalanche: hand Foe(Knockback Mag 6). NB the Homecoming binary shows this proc as a knockdown magnitude (<1), not Mag 6 — transcribed to the hand value.
_notes.Endless Nightmare: Recharge/Chance for F: Endless Nightmare / Superior (Rebirth): Foe Fear(8s) + conditional Psionic damage (shown as a damage proc, as before).
_notes.Absolute Resolution: Chance for Energy D: Absolute Resolution (Rebirth): Damage(Energy 7-72); Superior entered flat 72 in the hand string.
_notes.Liberty's Belt: Resistance/Global Damage: Liberty's Belt (Rebirth): always-on global +7.5% Damage to all the user's powers — the LotG +Recharge analogue for damage, Rule-of-5 capped. Never functional in Mids (the value is not cleanly in the boost template), hence hand-curated.
_notes.Synapse's Agility: Endurance Drain Resis: Synapse's Agility (Rebirth): always-on 20% resistance to endurance drain, fused onto the 6th piece. The bins carry it as an F-piece-gated auto power (Set_Bonus.Challenge_Set_Bonus.Synapses_Agility) whose two templates are 0.2×Melee_Ones on the Recovery and Endurance attribs — one named effect covering both drain axes, so the one category fans out to both debuff resists at the consumer.
_notes.Guardian's Gift: Chance for PBAoE Resolv: Guardian's Gift / Superior (Rebirth): PBAoE allies Absorb + Mez Prot + Mez Resist for 15s.
_notes.Subaluwa: Chance for Knockback: Subaluwa (Thunderspy): Foe(Knockback Mag 6) — Melee_Ones scale 6, PvE only.
_notes.Forced Indoctrination: Chance for Psioni: Forced Indoctrination (Rebirth): Psionic 0.67 × Melee_TempDamage = 6.7–71.75. Winter Storm and its Superior (Rebirth) carry the same template on Cold.
_notes.Primalist's Nature: Recharge/Primal Ener: Primalist's Nature / Superior (Thunderspy): +1 / +2 Primal Energy (the Rage meter, 10 per point), not on PvP maps. A self meter no surface models, hence Special.
